## 本周报道 | This week’s report

**中文。** 本周报道介绍 Großeibstadt 的石质铸范和 Grabenstätt 的晚青铜时代铜器组合。巴伐利亚文物保护局的新闻索引亦确认，本次展示包括下弗兰肯的石范和上巴伐利亚的青铜发现。这些材料可作为金属生产与收藏管理的阅读线索，不另赋予发现等级或排名。

**English.** This week’s report covers stone casting moulds from Großeibstadt and a Late Bronze Age bronze assemblage from Grabenstätt. The heritage agency’s press index independently confirms the presentation of Lower Franconian moulds and Upper Bavarian bronze finds. They provide leads on metal production and collection stewardship, without receiving a new archive grade or rank.

## 日期与既往工作 | Dates and earlier work

**中文。** 报道称 Großeibstadt 石范出土于 2025 年夏；Grabenstätt 铜器始见于 2024 年，后续调查持续至 2026 年。官方展示日期为 2026-11-11。

**English.** The report places the Großeibstadt mould excavation in summer 2025 and the first Grabenstätt finds in 2024, followed by surveys through 2026. The official presentation was on 2026-11-11.

## 解释边界 | Limits of interpretation

**中文。** 两个地点不能合并成同一处遗址；铜器组合曾受扰动。官方新闻索引可读，但详细 PDF 本次未能读取，具体数量与“最大／唯一”比较性说法不作为已核实结论转载。

**English.** The two places are distinct sites, and the hoard was disturbed. The official press index was accessible but its detailed PDF was not; exact totals and comparative largest/unique claims are not reproduced as verified conclusions.
